ns2:section.sectionText: All seats are reserved for Psychology majors until April 16th. Seniors have Priority on April 4th, Juniors on April 11th. An overview of how psychological stress impacts mental and physical health. In this interactive, activity-based (not lecture-based) course, topics to be covered include conceptualization of stress and coping, the biology of the stress response, the role of stress in specific disorders, and stress management interventions. **Elective course for Clinical/Community or Intradisciplinary Psychology Concentration**
